name: colony-self-verify
description: Full colony self-verification audit — checks PIDs, skills, mistakes, routes, projects, surfaces, connectors, index integrity, cross-colony sync, and reports gaps.

checks.name: PID Registry Health
checks.description: Verify spawn-pid-registry.json exists, active PIDs are real, history is capped

checks.name: Agent Roles Completeness
checks.description: Verify all expected roles exist in AGENT_ROLES

checks.name: IX Cache Status
checks.description: Check if file watcher is active and cache is functioning

checks.name: IX Type Canonicality
checks.description: All IX entries must use one of 12 canonical types

checks.name: IX Frontmatter Completeness
checks.description: Every IX-*.md must have ix, name, type, tags fields in frontmatter

checks.name: Skills Coverage
checks.description: Compare skills/ folders against IX skill entries

checks.name: Routes Coverage
checks.description: Compare routes/*.js handler counts against IX route entries

checks.name: Connector PID Wiring
checks.description: All connectors that spawn processes must have despawnPid hooks

checks.name: Catalog Sync Health
checks.description: Check local catalog snapshot and remote catalogs received

checks.name: MQTT Retained Messages
checks.description: Verify presence and health topics are published

checks.name: Despawn Protocol in Briefings
checks.description: buildSpawnContext must include DESPAWN PROTOCOL text
